item.description:
【the-decoder.com】Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window. item.title: Negotiating Ontological Boundaries in User-Authored Personal Sensing Systems
item.description:
